taste.instructions: This is the brief of a software workload an autonomous coding agent is about to run. Does the work turn on visual or interaction taste, where a person has to look at the result and steer it (UI layout, styling, copy, animation, look and feel), rather than on behaviour a test can check?

criteria.yes: the result is judged mostly by how it looks or feels to a person: UI, styling, layout, visual design, wording, interaction
criteria.no: the result is judged mostly by behaviour a test, a diff or a command can check: logic, data, APIs, infrastructure, tooling

ambiguous.instructions: This is the brief of a software workload an autonomous coding agent is about to run. Is the brief ambiguous: does it leave open what done looks like, or several readings that would lead to different work, so the agent would have to guess what the person wants?

criteria.yes: done is unclear or several readings lead to different work; the agent would have to guess intent
criteria.no: the brief names what to change and what done looks like clearly enough to act on without guessing
